response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, with notable contributions to tooling and open-source projects, but lacks explicit, recent experience with JVM ecosystems, Spring, or enterprise IDE tooling — core requirements for this role. His Java exposure is historical and unverified in depth, and his current work is heavily focused on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, raising concerns about JVM expertise and IDE internals knowledge.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility with proven ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks.
Active open-source contributor with tools demonstrating systems thinking and developer tooling interest.
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and teaching experience in software practices.
concerns: No recent or demonstrable deep experience with Java/Kotlin, Spring, or JVM tooling in current or recent roles.
Primary tech focus is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang; Java appears only in legacy or minor contexts.
Lack of evidence of work on IDE internals, language servers, or enterprise build/server integration systems.
